<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

Show or change the CLI configuration.

Panel: [Settings](/docs/reference/cli/panels/settings/).

## Usage

```text
huron config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                                   | Description                  |
| ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| [`huron config show`](#huron-config-show) | Print the configuration.     |
| [`huron config set`](#huron-config-set)   | Set one configuration value. |

## `huron config show`

Print the configuration.

```text
huron config show [OPTIONS]
```

## `huron config set`

Set one configuration value.

```text
huron config set [OPTIONS] KEY VALUE
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description                                                                       |
| -------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `KEY`    | str  | One of `api_url`, `issuer`, `client_id`, `mount_prefix`, `acl_backend`. Required. |
| `VALUE`  | str  | Required.                                                                         |
